question: Girish Karnad who passed away in 2019, was awarded the 'Padma Shri' in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1974**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Girish Karnad**, a renowned playwright, actor, and director, was awarded the **'Padma Shri' in 1974**.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Girish Karnad was celebrated for his significant contributions to Indian theater and cinema, and his works often explored themes of mythology, history, and contemporary socio-political issues.
 
• He was also a recipient of other prestigious awards such as the **Jnanpith Award** and the **Padma Bhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Girish Karnad** was born on 19 May 1938 and passed away on 10 June 2019.
 
• He wrote several notable plays including **'Yayati', 'Tughlaq', 'Hayavadana', 'Nagamandala', and 'Taledanda'**.
 
• In addition to his contributions to theater, Karnad also acted in numerous films and television series, earning acclaim for his performances.
 
• His legacy continues to inspire new generations of playwrights, actors, and filmmakers in India and beyond.
